_standards: See STANDARDS.md. Requirement classes and readiness tiers are enforced by catalog/schema/entity_schema_3.0.json.
_readiness_note: STUB. Structure only. Every aircraft-specific value is a DECLARED gap carrying a todo that names what would close it - contrast UAS-QUAD-SKYDIO-X2D, where several keys are absent entirely and report as NOT RECORDED. Both entities are unmodelable and both are refused by the gate; only one of them tells the next person where to look.
_stub_note: Sub-250 g class. Worth modelling because the mass and disk-area sensitivities that dominate the Mavic 3's endurance behave very differently at a quarter of the mass. This entity is therefore a genuine test of whether the model generalises, rather than another data point sitting next to the one it was calibrated on.

mass_kg.todo: Takeoff weight. DJI specifications page. Confirm whether the published figure includes battery and propellers - the sub-250 g regulatory class creates an incentive to quote the most flattering configuration.

propeller_diameter_m.todo: Propeller diameter from the DJI part designation, converted from inches. Do not assume it scales from the Mavic 3.

rotor_count.note: Definitional from the category, not a measurement.

capacity_wh.todo: Intelligent Flight Battery energy in Wh, from the DJI specifications page. Check whether the figure is for the standard or the Plus battery - they differ, and quoting the wrong one changes every endurance number this model produces.

voltage_full_v.todo: DJI charge voltage limit. Do NOT assume the standard LiPo 4.2 V per cell figure - that exact error is already on the record against the Mavic 3, see VALIDATION.md section 7.

chemistry.todo: DJI battery documentation. Li-ion and LiPo have different discharge curves and different safe cutoffs; the Mavic 3 record was corrected on exactly this point.

performance_published._note: No performance figure has been sourced yet. Expect DJI's specifications page and its manual to disagree, as they do for the Mavic 3 hover time. Record both and set contested rather than picking one.

max_hover_time_min.todo: Hover endurance. THIS IS THE CALIBRATION ANCHOR - no parameter can be fitted without it. Check the specifications page against the manual.

max_flight_time_min.todo: Flight endurance. Capture the constant speed it was measured at at the same time, or the cruise anchor cannot be scored.

flight_time_test_speed_ms.todo: The speed the flight-time figure was measured at. Without it the cruise anchor is unscorable, which is what happened to the wind anchor catalog-wide.

max_flight_distance_km.todo: Maximum flight distance. Held-out validation anchor.

max_speed_ms.todo: Maximum speed. Sets the best-range search ceiling.

max_wind_resistance_ms.todo: Wind resistance. Note this anchor is UNSCORED catalog-wide - no wind predictor is pre-registered - so recording it does not make it scorable.

performance_operational._note: Independent measurements go here once found. The Mavic 3 record shows real-world endurance landing at 65 to 75 percent of the published figure; do not assume the same ratio holds at a quarter of the mass.

observed_flight_time_min.todo: Independent measured endurance range, from published review testing or owner reports. Record as a two-element range, not a point.

usable_energy_fraction.todo: Reserve policy. 0.85 is the doctrine figure used elsewhere in this catalog, but adopt it explicitly rather than by default.

operational_overhead_factor.todo: Derive from observed against published endurance once both exist. Deriving it any other way makes the operational profile unfalsifiable.

air_density_kg_m3.note: Environmental constant, not an aircraft property.

equivalent_flat_plate_area_m2.todo: Airframe-specific drag area. Estimate from frontal area and a bluff-body Cd, or identify it from a tilt-versus-wind sweep the way test_3b_wind.py does for the simulator's airframe.

figure_of_merit.source: Rotorcraft literature, typical small electric multirotor
figure_of_merit.note: Class-typical modelling assumption carried at the same literature citation the rest of the catalog uses. It is NOT a measurement of this airframe and must be revisited before this entity is briefed. Small rotors at low Reynolds number may well sit below 0.65.

motor_esc_efficiency.source: Rotorcraft literature, typical small electric multirotor
motor_esc_efficiency.note: Class-typical modelling assumption, not a measurement of this airframe.

propulsive_efficiency.source: Rotorcraft literature, typical small electric multirotor
propulsive_efficiency.note: Class-typical modelling assumption, not a measurement of this airframe.

avionics_power_w.todo: Airframe-specific. Needs a hover current draw measurement or a teardown estimate. The Mavic 3 figure of 15 W is roughly 13 percent of its hover draw; at this aircraft's mass the same absolute figure would be a far larger fraction, so carrying it across would be a significant modelling error.

thrust_coefficient.todo: Propeller-specific C_T. Needs the propeller model, then a UIUC propeller database lookup or a static thrust bench test.

profile_power_mu_factor.source: Standard rotorcraft profile power growth form P = P0 (1 + 4.65 mu^2)

calibration._note: Declared intent. Nothing can be fitted until the hover anchor and the physical parameters exist.
